input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment (with the exception of any Service Option Attachment that is a prerequisite for the provision of Services under a non-terminated Service Option Attachment) for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
input.rationale: Section 3.4 is Customer-only (IBM has no convenience right; under 3.3 its only mid-term exit is material breach, and its only other exit is the 90-day non-renewal notice in 3.2, which we route to RENEWAL), but the Customer exit itself falls short: it bites only "at the end of any calendar month" on top of one month's notice, so the effective date can sit well beyond 30 days, and there is no refund of prepaid charges for the unused post-termination period, while 3.4(b) conditions the exit on open-ended early termination charges. We therefore take the preferred cure with three surgical edits: the right becomes exercisable at any time, the notice becomes thirty (30) days, and IBM must refund prepaid charges pro rata for the period after the effective date of termination. All favourable existing language ("if any", the prerequisite carve-out, 3.3's bar on IBM recovering 3.4(b) charges after its own breach) is preserved. If IBM resists, we would accept the fallback instead, with the 3.4(b) charges capped at three months' charges.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
mappings.quote: Customer or IBM may terminate this Agreement for material breach of this Agreement by the other upon written notice containing the specific nature and dates of the material breach.

proposal.summary: Make Customer's convenience termination effective at any time on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid charges.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have restated Customer's convenience right in Section 3.4 so it may be exercised at any time on thirty (30) days' notice rather than only at a calendar month end, and added IBM's pro-rata refund of prepaid charges for the post-termination period, per our preferred position.

ops.oldText: for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
ops.newText: for convenience at any time by:

ops.oldText: a. providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and
ops.newText: a. providing at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice to IBM; and

ops.text: IBM will refund to Customer, pro rata, any prepaid charges for the period after the effective date of termination.
